给在法国读完硕士层级文凭的人用来找工作或创业的 1 年期居留，有效期 1 年且明: A one-year residence permit for people who completed a master-level qualification in France, to look for work or start a business. It is valid for 1 year and expressly non-renewable; if you find a job before it expires you switch to a salarié or talent permit. Two situations: you are in France (you must hold an étudiant permit and have obtained the qualification within the last 12 months), or you have returned home (you may apply within 4 years of obtaining the qualification). You may work during this period and the employer is exempt from a work permit, but the job must relate to your field and pay more than €2,800.53 gross per month — a condition that rules out taking just any job.
官方未按国籍设限，中国大陆护照持有人可申。但门槛在前置身份而不在护照：必须在法国: The official rules set no nationality restriction, so mainland Chinese passport holders may apply. The threshold is the prior status rather than the passport: you must hold an étudiant (or étudiant-programme de mobilité) permit in France and have obtained one of the listed qualifications. People who have not studied in France are not eligible for this route — it is a bridge for staying on after graduation to look for work, not a standalone entry channel.
官方资格条件里没有年龄限制。0–99 表示「无年龄门槛」，不是「未核实」。: The official eligibility conditions include no age limit. A range of 0–99 means "no age threshold", not "to be verified".
须取得下列之一：licence professionnelle、Mastère: You must hold one of the following: licence professionnelle, Mastère Spécialisé, Master of Science (accredited by the conférence des grandes écoles), or **another qualification at least equivalent to master level**. Official wording: `Avoir obtenu au cours des 12 derniers mois, une licence professionnelle, un Mastère Spécialisé, un Master of Science (labellisé par la conférence des grandes écoles) ou un autre diplôme au moins équivalent au master`. A general bachelor degree (licence générale) does not qualify; licence professionnelle is the exception.
官方资格清单未单列语言考试要求。实际需要能处理法语行政材料；递交材料本身不要求提: The official eligibility list does not separately require a language test. In practice you need to be able to handle French administrative paperwork; the documents themselves do not require a French proficiency certificate.
官方未设独立的存款门槛（与瑞典要求按月证明资金不同）。但需提供医疗保险证明与住所: The official rules set no separate savings threshold (unlike Sweden, which requires funds proved month by month). You must, however, provide proof of health insurance and proof of accommodation, and you have to cover your own costs while looking for work.
两条路径按所在地分：①人在法国——须持 carte de séjour étud: Two paths, depending on where you are: (1) in France — you must hold a carte de séjour étudiant or étudiant-programme de mobilité and lodge with the préfecture or sous-préfecture for your place of residence within the 2 months before the student permit expires; (2) back home — the official wording requires the application within a maximum of 4 years from obtaining the qualification.
材料清单含 Justificatif d'assurance maladie（医: The document list includes proof of health insurance (the justificatif for health cover on the official list).
官方材料清单包含 « Déclaration sur l'honneur de: The official document list includes a declaration of non-polygamy, which applies only to married applicants from countries that permit polygamy. It is not an extra requirement for Chinese applicants, but the item is on the list.
官方页面未设名额、抽签或年度配额的表述，属资格制：满足条件即受理。真正的「名额」: The official page contains no quota, ballot or annual quota wording; it is qualification-based, so applications meeting the conditions are accepted. The real quota constraint is not on this route but on the later switch to a salarié or talent permit, where the employer and job conditions apply.
无年度开放窗口。时间节点跟着学生居留到期走：人在法国须在 étudiant 居留: No annual opening window. The timing follows the expiry of the student permit: in France you must lodge within the 2 months before the étudiant permit expires; if you have returned home you may apply at any time within 4 years of obtaining the qualification.
rolling：官方无固定开放窗口，申请时点取决于个人学生居留的到期日。date: rolling — the official page sets no fixed opening window, and the timing of your application depends on the expiry date of your own student permit. date_confidence is recorded as unknown because with no window there is no date whose reliability is in question, not because the research was incomplete. lead_time_days=45 because you need the qualification or proof of success, health insurance, proof of accommodation (within 3 months), photographs, and préfecture appointment waiting time; the official lodging window is itself only the 2 months before expiry, so once appointment queues are deducted the practical preparation period is tight.
全年按个人学生居留到期节点受理。人在法国者：学生居留到期前 2 个月内递交至住所: Applications are accepted all year around the expiry date of your own student permit. In France: lodge with the préfecture or sous-préfecture for your place of residence within the 2 months before the student permit expires. Back home: apply within 4 years of obtaining the qualification.
无年度窗口。规则按 service-public.fr 当期版本执行；该页会随法: No annual window. The rules follow the version of service-public.fr in force at the time; that page is updated as the regulations change, so re-check before lodging.
官方原文：`Vous devez payer 150 € (droit de t: Official wording: `Vous devez payer 150 € (droit de timbre de 50 € + taxe de 100 €) par timbres fiscaux.` That is a €50 revenue stamp plus a €100 tax, paid in the form of tax stamps. For the VLS-TS issued abroad the official page says only that you pay the VLS-TS fee first and then €100 on validation after arriving in France, with no total given; this record does not fill in that number.
官方页面未给固定审理天数。实际时长取决于 préfecture 预约排期与材料完: The official page gives no fixed processing period. Actual timing depends on préfecture appointment scheduling and how complete the file is; the 2-month lodging window before the student permit expires means it may not be enough when the queues are long.

If the certificate has not yet been issued, use an `attestation de réussite définitive au diplôme` (final proof of success).
